tests.title: Projection-collapse audit
tests.description: Checks whether existential projection or forgetting auxiliary variables can collapse the chosen rank, width, or certificate measure.

tests.title: Degree-preserving isomorphism audit
tests.description: Separates coordinate renaming and complementation from substitutions that increase polynomial degree or change the quotient ring.

tests.title: Extension dependency-depth audit
tests.description: Charges the transitive depth, fan-in, fan-out, and sharing pattern of auxiliary definitions rather than local scope alone.

tests.title: Restriction-robustness audit
tests.description: Tests whether hardness, pseudoexpectations, or residual structure survive the restrictions used in lower-bound proofs.

tests.title: Pseudocalibration and planted-null audit
tests.description: Attempts to construct low-degree pseudo-distributions from planted and null distributions and checks PSD and explicitness obligations.

tests.title: Conditioning and weak-infeasibility audit
tests.description: Requires quantitative primal and dual margins before treating numerical SDP output as a short exact certificate.

tests.title: Canonical observable-interface audit
tests.description: Requires every profile or statistic family to be finite, coordinate-normalized, and fixed independently of the answer bit.

tests.title: Local-round universality audit
tests.description: Checks whether a finite local rule set becomes computationally universal through polynomially many sequential rounds.

tests.title: Cross-system measure-preservation audit
tests.description: Checks that a translation preserves degree, size, bit length, and semantic soundness between theta, SoS, DNNF, or proof systems.

tests.title: Terminal-salvage audit
tests.description: Requires descendants of destroyed or rejected nodes to remove the exact failure rather than merely rename the parent.
